sam: Auditor requested evidence for RBAC rollout that changed edit rights for service accounts in prod between 2026-02-01 and 2026-02-10. Also asked for proof of emergency KMS key rotation that was performed during INC-2026-004. Need mapping to SOC2 CC6 and ISO A.9.

lina: Got it. Which artifacts do they want? My guess: PRs, kube audit snippets, KMS key rotation logs, and the incident timeline.

sam: Exactly. They want chain-of-custody for the RBAC change (ticket, PR, approver) plus the actual `kubectl` output pre/post and the diff. Also need the KMS rotation entry with KMS key IDs and who triggered rotation.

ops: Emergency rotation was run with `kms rotate-key --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111:key/8a2b... --reason INC-2026-004` by service account `svc-rotator@infra`. CloudTrail shows `RotateKey` event at 2026-02-05T03:12:08Z. I can export that.

devops-bot: export queued: export-3141607777-rotations (includes: cloudtrail-rotatekey-INC-2026-004.json, kube-rbac-prepost-diff.tar.gz, pr-metadata-*.csv). ETA ~8m.

lina: For PR metadata, include GitHub audit entry `event: pull_request, action: closed, merged_by: ryan, merged_at: 2026-02-03T14:22:10Z, pr: 1289`. Also attach CODEOWNERS approvals.

sam: Auditor also asked for proof that RBAC change went through the usual review flow vs emergency bypass. We need to highlight any bypasses and an explanation.

ops: There was an emergency bypass for a hotfix on 2026-02-04: PR 1292 was merged using the `emergency` label following on-call approval recorded in PagerDuty note `PD-944`. I'll pull the PagerDuty note export.

auditor_khan: For SOC2/ISO: we need a single mapping.csv with control -> evidence file -> short rationale. Also want per-actor activity for any service account used for KMS operations. If a human triggered rotate, include username and 2FA proof (screenshot of audit UI is OK).

lina: A note: kube audit contains pod names and IPs that could be sensitive. We'll redact pod IDs and replace with `POD-<hash>`. We'll keep actor principals intact (they're corporate usernames).

security-bot: redaction-job started: redact-3141607777-kube, status=running.

ops: CloudTrail export prepared: `cloudtrail-rotatekey-INC-2026-004.json` (rows=6) includes `eventTime, eventName, userIdentity.principalId, awsRegion, requestParameters`. I will add a README explaining what fields were redacted and why.

lina: Vulnerability note: the RBAC tighten was in response to advisory ADV-2026-02 (privilege escalation in dependency Y). Include triage notes: `triage.md` + risk decision `risk-acceptance-ADV-2026-02.pdf`.

devops-bot: export update: export-3141607777-rotations status=ready. Download: https://internal-exports.redwood.com/exports/3141607777-rotations

auditor_khan: I downloaded the bundle. Two quick asks: 1) Can you provide a CSV mapping of service account -> roles pre/post? 2) For the KMS rotation, show which encrypted blobs (S3 object keys) may have been re-encrypted or required rewrapping.

sam: I'll produce `svc-account-rolemap.csv` with columns `principal,role_before,role_after,change_reason` and `rbac-chain.csv` with `ticket,pr,approver,timestamp`.

ops: For re-encryption: we didn't rewrap objects at rotation time; we used key alias swap. I'll document that in `kms-rotation-notes.txt` and run a query to list objects that were accessed during the window.

lina: Packaging owner: me. I'll assemble: `mapping.csv` (control->evidence), `svc-account-rolemap.csv`, `rbac-chain.csv`, `kms-rotation-notes.txt`, `triage.md`, `retention-policy-snapshot.yaml`, and redacted kube audit. Upload to secure share and send auditor link.

security-bot: upload complete: s3://secure-exports/audits/2026-02-rotation-3141607777/ (permissions: auditor_khan read-only).

auditor_khan: Thanks. I'll review and follow up with any clarifying Qs. If you can add an explicit note mapping SOC2 CC6.1->rbac-chain.csv and ISO A.9.2->svc-account-rolemap.csv that would speed review.

sam: Will add those mappings to `mapping.csv` before final drop.

lina: Done. I pushed final package and added a README describing redaction steps and how to validate the artifacts.

security-bot: thread export complete.
